intro: The Osaka corner table is your perfect space-saving companion—sleek, practical, and effortlessly elegant. Designed to fit seamlessly into any corner, it adds function without taking up precious room.

features.title: A Remini walnut finish
features.text: Add timeless charm to your space with the elegant walnut shade in a matte finish, seamlessly blending with modern or classic interiors for a refined look.

features.title: Compact and Functional Oval Design
features.text: Designed to fit perfectly into corners, this table maximises space while maintaining a stylish aesthetic, making it ideal for smaller rooms or multi-functional areas.

features.title: Durable Engineered Wood Build
features.text: Constructed with 18mm prelaminated particle board, it ensures long-lasting strength, stability, and resistance to everyday wear and tear, delivering exceptional value.

features.title: Dual-access open storage
features.text: Enjoy convenient storage accessible from both sides, perfect for keeping books, gadgets, or decorative pieces organised while enhancing the table’s versatile functionality.

features.title: Hassle-free setup, easy to move
features.text: Delivered flat-packed, this table is easy to assemble and move, ensuring convenience and adaptability for rearranging your living space whenever needed.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
